# Redpanda Connect inputs

benthos-umh includes the inputs of Redpanda Connect v4.117.0. Use them in bridges and stand-alone flows next to the UMH inputs.

The pages below cover the inputs used most with UMH. Their configuration and field reference are generated from the version benthos-umh includes, so they list the fields your instance accepts.

| Input | Name in config | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [MQTT](mqtt.md) | `mqtt` | Subscribe to topics on MQTT brokers. |
| [HTTP Client](http_client.md) | `http_client` | Connects to a server and continuously performs requests for a single message. |
| [Kafka / Redpanda](redpanda.md) | `redpanda` | A Kafka input using the [Franz Kafka client library](https://github.com/twmb/franz-go). |
| [SQL Select](sql_select.md) | `sql_select` | Executes a select query and creates a message for each row received. |
| [AMQP 0.9 (RabbitMQ)](amqp_0_9.md) | `amqp_0_9` | Connects to an AMQP (0.91) queue. AMQP is a messaging protocol used by various message brokers, including RabbitMQ. |

## Other inputs

benthos-umh also includes these inputs. They have no page here yet. The links go to Redpanda's documentation, which describes the latest Redpanda Connect release, so a field can differ from version v4.117.0.

| Name in config | Description |
|---|---|
| [`amqp_1`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/amqp_1/) | Reads messages from an AMQP (1.0) server. |
| [`aws_cloudwatch_logs`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/aws_cloudwatch_logs/) | Consumes log events from AWS CloudWatch Logs. |
| [`aws_dynamodb_cdc`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/aws_dynamodb_cdc/) | Reads change data capture (CDC) events from DynamoDB Streams. |
| [`aws_kinesis`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/aws_kinesis/) | Receive messages from one or more Kinesis streams. |
| [`aws_s3`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/aws_s3/) | Downloads objects within an Amazon S3 bucket, optionally filtered by a prefix, either by walking the items in the bucket or by streaming upload notifications in realtime. |
| [`aws_sqs`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/aws_sqs/) | Consume messages from an AWS SQS URL. |
| [`azure_blob_storage`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/azure_blob_storage/) | Downloads objects within an Azure Blob Storage container, optionally filtered by a prefix. |
| [`azure_cosmosdb`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/azure_cosmosdb/) | Executes a SQL query against [Azure CosmosDB](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cosmos-db/introduction) and creates a batch of messages from each page of items. |
| [`azure_queue_storage`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/azure_queue_storage/) | Dequeue objects from an Azure Storage Queue. |
| [`azure_table_storage`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/azure_table_storage/) | Queries an Azure Storage Account Table, optionally with multiple filters. |
| [`batched`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/batched/) | Consumes data from a child input and applies a batching policy to the stream. |
| [`beanstalkd`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/beanstalkd/) | Reads messages from a Beanstalkd queue. |
| [`broker`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/broker/) | Allows you to combine multiple inputs into a single stream of data, where each input will be read in parallel. |
| [`cassandra`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/cassandra/) | Executes a find query and creates a message for each row received. |
| [`cockroachdb_changefeed`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/cockroachdb_changefeed/) | Listens to a [CockroachDB Core Changefeed](https://www.cockroachlabs.com/docs/stable/changefeed-examples) and creates a message for each row received. |
| [`csv`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/csv/) | Reads one or more CSV files as structured records following the format described in RFC 4180. |
| [`discord`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/discord/) | Consumes messages posted in a Discord channel. |
| [`dynamic`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/dynamic/) | A special broker type where the inputs are identified by unique labels and can be created, changed and removed during runtime via a REST HTTP interface, which is disabled by default and enabled with the `bind_http` field. |
| [`file`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/file/) | Consumes data from files on disk, emitting messages according to a chosen codec. |
| [`gcp_bigquery_select`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/gcp_bigquery_select/) | Executes a `SELECT` query against BigQuery and creates a message for each row received. |
| [`gcp_cloud_storage`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/gcp_cloud_storage/) | Downloads objects within a Google Cloud Storage bucket, optionally filtered by a prefix. |
| [`gcp_pubsub`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/gcp_pubsub/) | Consumes messages from a GCP Cloud Pub/Sub subscription. |
| [`generate`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/generate/) | Generates messages at a given interval using a [Bloblang](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/guides/bloblang/about/) mapping executed without a context. This allows you to generate messages for testing your pipeline configs. |
| [`git`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/git/) | Clones a Git repository, reads its contents, then polls for new commits at a configurable interval. |
| [`hdfs`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/hdfs/) | Reads files from a HDFS directory, where each discrete file will be consumed as a single message payload. |
| [`http_server`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/http_server/) | Receive messages POSTed over HTTP(S). HTTP 2.0 is supported when using TLS, which is enabled when key and cert files are specified. |
| [`inproc`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/inproc/) | Directly connects to an output within the same process by a chosen ID, to link isolated streams when running in streams mode. |
| [`mongodb`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/mongodb/) | Executes a query and creates a message for each document received. |
| [`mysql_cdc`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/mysql_cdc/) | Streams data changes from a MySQL or MariaDB database, using the binary log to capture data updates. |
| [`nanomsg`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/nanomsg/) | Consumes messages via Nanomsg sockets (scalability protocols). |
| [`nats`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/nats/) | Subscribes to a NATS subject. |
| [`nats_jetstream`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/nats_jetstream/) | Reads messages from NATS JetStream subjects. |
| [`nats_kv`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/nats_kv/) | Watches for updates in a NATS key-value bucket. |
| [`nats_stream`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/nats_stream/) | Subscribes to a NATS Stream subject. Joining a queue is optional and allows multiple clients of a subject to consume using queue semantics. |
| [`nsq`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/nsq/) | Subscribe to an NSQ instance topic and channel. |
| [`ockam_kafka`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/ockam_kafka/) | Uses Ockam to decrypt and read end-to-end encrypted messages from Kafka topics. |
| [`otlp_grpc`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/otlp_grpc/) | Receive OpenTelemetry traces, logs, and metrics via OTLP/gRPC protocol. |
| [`otlp_http`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/otlp_http/) | Receive OpenTelemetry traces, logs, and metrics via OTLP/HTTP protocol. |
| [`parquet`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/parquet/) | Reads and decodes [Parquet files](https://parquet.apache.org/docs/) into a stream of structured messages. |
| [`postgres_cdc`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/postgres_cdc/) | Streams changes from a PostgreSQL database using logical replication. |
| [`pulsar`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/pulsar/) | Reads messages from an Apache Pulsar server. |
| [`read_until`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/read_until/) | Reads messages from a child input until a consumed message passes a [Bloblang query](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/guides/bloblang/about/), at which point the input closes. It is also possible to configure a timeout after which the input is closed if no new messages arrive in that period. |
| [`redis_list`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/redis_list/) | Pops messages from the beginning of a Redis list using the BLPop command. |
| [`redis_pubsub`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/redis_pubsub/) | Consume from a Redis publish/subscribe channel using either the SUBSCRIBE or PSUBSCRIBE commands. |
| [`redis_scan`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/redis_scan/) | Scans the set of keys in the current selected database and gets their values, using the Scan and Get commands. |
| [`redis_streams`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/redis_streams/) | Pulls messages from Redis (v5.0+) streams with the XREADGROUP command. The `client_id` should be unique for each consumer of a group. |
| [`redpanda_migrator`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/redpanda_migrator/) | Consumes records from a source Kafka or Redpanda cluster for the redpanda_migrator output to migrate. |
| [`resource`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/resource/) | Resource is an input type that channels messages from a resource input, identified by its name. |
| [`schema_registry`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/schema_registry/) | Reads schemas from a schema registry. |
| [`sequence`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/sequence/) | Reads messages from a sequence of child inputs, starting with the first and once that input gracefully terminates starts consuming from the next, and so on. |
| [`sftp`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/sftp/) | Consumes files from an SFTP server. |
| [`socket`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/socket/) | Connects to a tcp or unix socket and consumes a continuous stream of messages. |
| [`socket_server`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/socket_server/) | Creates a server that receives a stream of messages over a TCP, UDP or Unix socket. |
| [`spicedb_watch`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/spicedb_watch/) | Consume messages from the Watch API from SpiceDB. |
| [`sql_raw`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/sql_raw/) | Executes a select query and creates a message for each row received. |
| [`stdin`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/stdin/) | Consumes data piped to stdin, chopping it into individual messages according to the specified scanner. |
| [`subprocess`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/subprocess/) (beta) | Executes a command, runs it as a subprocess, and consumes messages from it over stdout. |
| [`timeplus`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/timeplus/) | Executes a query on Timeplus Enterprise and creates a message from each row received. |
| [`twitter_search`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/twitter_search/) (experimental) | Consumes tweets matching a given search using the Twitter recent search V2 API. |
| [`websocket`](https://docs.redpanda.com/redpanda-connect/components/inputs/websocket/) | Connects to a websocket server and continuously receives messages. |
